The main Java class of the solution should have exactly the same name as the task.

Submission details for compilation

Message Explanation
Compilation succeeded Your submission successfully compiled to an executable.
Compilation failed Your submission did not compile correctly.
Compilation timed out Your submission exceeded the time limit while compiling. This might be caused by an excessive use of C++ templates, for example.
Compilation memory limit exceeded Your submission exceeded the memory limit while compiling. This might be caused by an excessive use of C++ templates, or too large global variables, for example.
Compilation killed with signal %s Your submission was killed with the specified signal. This might be caused by a bug in the compiler, for example.

Submission details for evaluation

Message Explanation
Output is correct Your submission ran and gave the correct answer
Output is partially correct Your submission ran and gave the partially correct answer
Output isn't correct Your submission ran, but gave the wrong answer
Evaluation didn't produce file %s Your submission ran, but did not write on the correct output file
Execution timed out Your submission used too much CPU time.
Execution timed out (wall clock limit exceeded) Your submission used too much total time. This might be triggered by undefined code, or buffer overflow, for example. Note that in this case the CPU time visible in the submission details might be much smaller than the time limit.
Memory limit exceeded Your submission used too much memory.
Execution killed by signal The evaluation was killed by a signal.
Execution failed because the return code was nonzero Your submission failed because it exited with a return code different from 0.
